original_query: Sahaja Aharam links farmers to whom?

confirmed.answer_text: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative that links farmers to consumers.; It builds a supply chain on a Farmer to Consumer (F2C) model.; It enables direct retailing to consumers (bulk/individual consumers).
confirmed.summary: The page describes Sahaja Aharam as an F2C initiative that connects nature-friendly farmers with consumers by blending traditional bazaars with ecological concerns. It aims to increase farmers' income and provide consumers with healthy food through direct retailing and fair trade models.
key_facts: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative that links farmers to consumers.
It builds a supply chain on a Farmer to Consumer (F2C) model.
It enables direct retailing to consumers (bulk/individual consumers).
